name: The Grounds of Faith
author: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning
desc: The Grounds of Faith (1852): four lectures delivered at St. George's, Southwark, on the foundation of Christian faith: revealed truth definite and certain, the Church as a historical witness and as a divine witness, and rationalism as the legitimate consequence of private judgment.
desc_pt: Os Fundamentos da Fé (1852): quatro conferências pronunciadas em St. George, Southwark, sobre o fundamento da fé cristã: a verdade revelada, definida e certa, a Igreja como testemunha histórica e como testemunha divina, e o racionalismo como consequência legítima do livre exáme.
editor: Henry Edward Manning (London: Burns and Lambert, 1852)
edition: The Grounds of Faith (London: Burns and Lambert, 1852), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The four lectures; the contents and the publisher's list of books are dropped.
